document_title: Tata Electric Vehicle Powertrain & High-Voltage Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 4: High-Voltage System Safety & Battery Management
section: Section 4.2: High-Voltage Interlock Loop (HVIL) Fault Isolation
content:
FAULT CODE: P0A0C - High Voltage Interlock Circuit Low.
SYMPTOM: Vehicle fails to enter 'READY' drive state; High-Voltage warning lamp illuminated on digital instrument cluster.
SAFETY PRECAUTION: Always wear Class 0 (1000V rated) insulating gloves and arc-flash face shield before interacting with HV distribution box (PDU).
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Turn vehicle ignition OFF. Wait minimum 10 minutes to allow DC-link intermediate capacitors inside the dual-inverter to discharge below 12V DC.
Step 2: Disconnect the 12V auxiliary battery negative terminal.
Step 3: Remove the Manual Service Disconnect (MSD) safety plug located beneath the rear passenger seat assembly (Section 4.1, Page 45).
Step 4: Using a calibrated Digital Multimeter (CAT III 1000V certified), probe HVIL continuity across connector PDU-X02 Pins 3 and 7. Standard expected resistance is 0.5 to 1.8 Ohms.
Step 5: If resistance exceeds 2.5 Ohms, inspect the high-voltage interlock microswitch pins on the AC-DC on-board charger (OBC) and battery pack lid.
TORQUE SPECIFICATION: PDU M6 ground bolt must be torqued to 9.5 Nm ± 0.5 Nm.

document_title: Tata Electric Vehicle Powertrain & High-Voltage Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 5: Battery Management System (BMS) Cell Balancing
section: Section 5.4: Cell Voltage Asymmetry & State-of-Health (SOH) Degradation
content:
FAULT CODE: P0A80 - Replace Hybrid/EV Battery Pack; DTC P0B24 - Hybrid Battery Pack Voltage Uneven.
CRITERIA: Triggered when delta V (maximum cell voltage minus minimum cell voltage) exceeds 35 mV across the 96S module string during continuous discharge, or when cell internal resistance delta exceeds 15%.
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Connect OEM diagnostic scan tool (Tata Diagnostic Suite v4.2+) to OBD-II port under steering column.
Step 2: Navigate to BMS Live Data Stream: Monitor Cell Voltages #01 through #96.
Step 3: Execute active balancing routine via bidirectional control menu. Allow balancing cycle to run for 120 minutes with vehicle connected to slow AC 3.3kW wall-box charger.
Step 4: If cell delta remains above 30 mV after 2 consecutive balancing cycles, perform module-level isolation test (Section 5.6, Page 68).
Step 5: Measure module cooling plate inlet temperature sensor (NTC Thermistor). Nominal resistance at 25°C is 10.0 kOhm ± 0.3 kOhm.
WARNING: Do not charge vehicle if any individual cell temperature reports above 55°C.

document_title: Tata Electric Vehicle Powertrain & High-Voltage Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 6: Traction Inverter & Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM)
section: Section 6.3: Inverter IGBT Phase Overcurrent & Resolver Angle Offset
content:
FAULT CODE: P0C17 - Drive Motor Position Sensor Calibration Not Learned; DTC P0A3F - Drive Motor A Position Sensor Circuit.
SYMPTOM: Severe motor judder upon initial torque request; vehicle enters limp-home mode with speed restricted to 20 km/h.
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Check resolver wiring harness between Motor Controller (MCU) 26-pin harness and PMSM tail-end housing. Verify shield ground resistance is < 0.2 Ohm.
Step 2: Perform Sin/Cos excitation coil impedance check: Sine winding resistance should measure 18.0 Ohm ± 1.5 Ohm at 20°C. Cosine winding resistance should measure 18.0 Ohm ± 1.5 Ohm.
Step 3: If coil resistance is within specification, conduct Resolver Offset Auto-Zeroing procedure using diagnostic tool with drive wheels raised on a two-post hydraulic lift.
Step 4: Inspect MCU coolant supply line for air lock. Minimum coolant flow rate must be 8.5 Liters/min at 3500 RPM pump speed.
TORQUE SPECIFICATION: Motor resolver retaining screws M4: 3.2 Nm ± 0.3 Nm.

document_title: Tata Electric Vehicle Powertrain & High-Voltage Service Manual
chapter: Chapter 7: Thermal Management & Heat Pump System
section: Section 7.1: Coolant Pressure Drop & Multi-way Valve Actuation
subsystem: Battery and Drive Unit Thermal Management
content:
FAULT CODE: P0E1E - Hybrid/EV Battery Coolant Pump 'A' Control Range/Performance.
SYMPTOM: Rapid battery de-rating in ambient temperatures > 40°C; Fast charging rate throttles from 50 kW down to 12 kW.
DIAGNOSTIC WORKFLOW:
Step 1: Check coolant expansion tank level. Verify fluid is approved low-conductivity 50/50 ethylene glycol OAT EV coolant (Part #TAT-EV-CLNT-01).
Step 2: Inspect 4-way coolant distribution valve (Octovalve/Multiport Valve) stepper motor connector C-408 for pin corrosion or bent pins.
Step 3: Measure supply voltage on Pin 1 of pump harness with ignition ON: Must be 12.0V to 14.2V DC. Pin 2 (PWM speed signal) must display 100 Hz square wave.
Step 4: Pressure test cooling circuit to 1.5 bar (21.7 psi) using adapter TAT-T-992. Pressure drop must not exceed 0.05 bar over 15 minutes.
